guide.summary: Temple ruins, national museums and riverside hotel dining in Ayutthaya, with breakfast rooms, rooftop bars and a café-bakery checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museums around their closing days: the Chao Sam Phraya Gold building's 2022 notice says it is closed on Mondays, and the Arts of the Kingdom Museum is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Chao Sam Phraya National Museum's Gold building is closed on Mondays (2022 notice). The Arts of the Kingdom Museum is closed on Mondays, Tuesdays, the New Year holidays and Songkran.

toolkit.label: Temple tickets
toolkit.copy: The Fine Arts Department's 2026 notice gives foreign visitors 80 baht for one site or 300 baht for a combined ticket. It covers Wat Mahathat, Wat Ratchaburana, Wat Phra Ram, Wat Phra Si Sanphet, Wat Chaiwatthanaram, Wat Maheyong and Wat Kudi Dao.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: The free Arts of the Kingdom Museum shuttle from Bangkok runs Wednesday to Sunday until 26 December 2026 and needs advance reservation. Elephantstay takes bookings by email, or by phone with less than 24 hours' notice.

toolkit.label: Arrival rules
toolkit.copy: Elephantstay asks you to arrive at 9:30am with no exceptions and to pay in Thai baht cash on arrival. Its family package needs at least one child aged 12 or under.

guide.dek: Start at the island temples early, then plan museum visits around their Monday and Tuesday closures.
intro: Ayutthaya Historical Park is run by the Fine Arts Department, and its 2026 notice prices one site at 80 baht for foreign visitors. A 300-baht combined ticket covers seven sites. On the island, Wat Mahathat stands beside Wat Ratchaburana, and the department's site page notes the eight-sided tiered chedi and the Buddha head held in tree roots. Wat Phra Si Sanphet occupies the former royal palace grounds in Pratu Chai, with three large bell-shaped chedis. Wat Phra Ram faces its old reservoir, now Bueng Phra Ram public park.

Across the Chao Phraya on the west bank, Wat Chaiwatthanaram hosts the park's larger events. Off the island, the combined ticket also covers Wat Maheyong in Han Tra, where about 80 stucco elephants ring the chedi. The ticket also covers Wat Kudi Dao in Phai Ling, whose east side faces the Wat Maheyong entrance. Neither site page publishes opening hours, so you should arrive in daylight and confirm times locally.

For context, the Chao Sam Phraya National Museum on Pridi Banomyong Road displays 2,244 objects in its Ayutthaya Gold building. Many came from the Wat Ratchaburana crypt, and its 2022 notice gives Tuesday to Sunday, 09.00–16.00. Chantharakasem National Museum sits on U Thong Road in Hua Ro. Further south, the Arts of the Kingdom Museum in Koh Kerd opens Wednesday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Its free shuttle from Bangkok runs until 26 December 2026 and needs advance reservation. The Japanese Village lists daily hours of 9.30 a.m. to 17.00.

For food, Centara Ayutthaya's House of Kin serves breakfast from 06:30, and its 1350 Rooftop Bar opens 17:00–24:00. The hotel's Summer Coffee café and bakery is open 07:00–21:00. On U-Thong Road, Sala Ayutthaya's Eatery and Bar lists daily hours of 7:00 am to 10:00 pm, and its Rooftop Lounge & Bar serves cocktails until 10:00 pm. Both sets of Sala hours come from a page last marked 2024. Baan Pomphet opens for lunch and dinner and takes reservations by phone or email.
summaryCards: Buy the combined Fine Arts Department ticket and start at Wat Mahathat and Wat Ratchaburana, then cross to Wat Chaiwatthanaram.
Have breakfast at House of Kin from 06:30, then visit the Chao Sam Phraya National Museum, which its 2022 notice says is closed on Mondays.
Avoid Mondays and Tuesdays for the Arts of the Kingdom Museum, and reserve its free Bangkok shuttle in advance.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Fine Arts Department's site pages for individual temples publish no opening hours. The department's older service page gives foreign fees of 50 baht single and 220 baht combined, which differ from the 2026 notice used here (80 and 300 baht). Chao Sam Phraya museum hours and its Monday closure come from a December 2022 notice and were not restated on a 2026 page. Chantharakasem museum hours were not published on the pages read. Sala Ayutthaya hours come from pages marked 2024. Baan Pomphet, Elephantstay and both Krungsri River Hotel outlets had no dated 2026 text, and the Krungsri River outlets publish no hours. The Japanese Village's new admission fees are only in an image. Baan Hollanda returned nothing readable, Kantary's hotel site returned 403, Classic Kameo's domain did not resolve, Baan Thai House had a certificate error, and the Starbucks Thailand store locator returned 403. No official sites were found for Bang Pa-In Palace, Wat Phanan Choeng, Wat Yai Chai Mongkhon or several well-known local restaurants, so they are omitted. Only 21 places could be confirmed, below the 25 to 35 target.
